summary: Iteration 152 — Independent verification of the 5 EU CRA Governance enhancements. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter152_cra_scorecard_brief.py = 8/8 PASS: (1) GET /api/cra/controls — every control now carries product_status:[{ref,name,status}] where status ∈ {Conforming,Partial,Nonconforming,Not Assessed}; overall.percentage still valid; (2) GET /api/cra/digest/brief.pdf returns application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment, %PDF magic, >500 bytes; a fresh org with 0 CRA products → 400 with the expected 'Add or load a CRA product first' message; (3) POST /api/cra/scorecard-link returns {token,expires_at,path:/cra-scorecard/<token>}; non-admin → 403; 5-active cap enforced with HTTP 429 on the 6th mint; (4) GET /api/cra-public/scorecard/{token} (no auth) returns {organization, overall{percentage,implemented,partial,gaps,not_started,high_risk,requirements_total,products_assessed,products_total}, top_gaps:[{requirement_id,domain,title,compliance_rate,status,risk}], next_deadline, note}; no product_status key and no admin product names/refs anywhere in the payload; passing an AUDITOR token → 403 ('not a compliance scorecard link'); (5) POST /api/cra/products/{ref}/verification-link — created a fresh product and confirmed 5×200 then the 6th → HTTP 429. Frontend Playwright (admin jblan2026@gmail.com, Chromium 1920x1080): logged in and dismissed onboarding tour. Control Dashboard tab renders cra-controls-overall='82%' + cra-controls-table with 18 cra-control-row-<REQID> rows; clicking the first row opens cra-control-drill listing 'Aegis Identity Broker · Partial', 'Test Firewall · Conforming', 'Acme VPN Gateway · Not Assessed'. cra-download-brief downloaded obserra-eu-cra-weekly-brief.pdf (3942 bytes, %PDF header). cra-scorecard-generate produced the copyable cra-scorecard-link block with a /cra-scorecard/<token> URL and a cra-scorecard-copy button. Regulatory Ledger tab, product CRA-PROD-00012: cra-verify-access shows RELATIVE time — 'Auditor last opened this product's link 18 minutes ago · 4 views' — and the title attribute (hover) contains the exact UTC time 'Wed, 12 Aug 2026 23:53:43 GMT'. For a product with no auditor views (CRA-PROD-00013), the fallback message 'No auditor has opened this product's verification link yet.' renders. Settings → cra-digest-download downloads obserra-eu-cra-weekly-brief.pdf (3950 bytes, %PDF) with success toast 'This week's CRA brief downloaded.'. Public scorecard /cra-scorecard/<token> loads in a fresh browser context (no auth) — cra-scorecard-overall = '82%', cra-scorecard-gaps table populated, no product names ('Aegis Identity Broker','Test Firewall','Acme VPN Gateway','Iter152 GuardTest') or the string 'product_status' appear anywhere in the DOM.

issues: Carry-over benign hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside product <select> — same as iter151; no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: cra_governance.py is 1403 lines — extract digest (PDF + settings + send-now) and scorecard/portal token endpoints into dedicated modules (cra_digest.py, cra_portal.py) to keep the file <700 lines. Same recommendation carries over from iter151.
CRAGovernance.jsx has grown further with ControlDashboard drill dialog + scorecard controls — split ControlDashboard/RegulatoryLedger into their own files (<500 LOC each). Still one page today.

Guardrail message is org-scoped for scorecard-link ('This organisation already has 5 active scorecard links') but product-scoped for verification-link — consider surfacing a 'revoke existing links' button next to the 429 toast so admins can recover in-app instead of waiting for expiry.

The Control Dashboard drill dialog data-testid is 'cra-control-drill' but shows no per-status counts (only per-product status). Consider a header summary '3 Conforming · 2 Partial · 1 Not Assessed' for large product portfolios.
Public scorecard payload includes ISO 'expires_at' (good) but the UI does not render it — consider showing 'Link expires 9/12/2026' on the public page so recipients know when it will stop working.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (drill dialog, brief PDF, scorecard mint/copy, ledger relative time+UTC hover, settings PDF, public scorecard w/o auth)
